entries.title: Observer

emulation.notes: Use the native System Redux PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with scalable settings, ray-tracing-capable hardware support, and capture flexibility.

primary.why: Observer: System Redux is the best route for the original Observer because it is the upgraded and expanded version with redesigned visuals, rebuilt mechanics, and additional story content, while the PC release gives the highest-fidelity capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Observer: System Redux on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Use the 2017 original only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: System Redux is an upgraded and expanded version, not the untouched 2017 release.

entries.title: Observer: System Redux

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with scalable settings, ray-tracing-capable hardware support, and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best System Redux route because it is the expanded version with redesigned visuals, rebuilt mechanics, and extra story content, plus the strongest capture and settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Observer: System Redux on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Console versions are fine for platform preference but are not the primary archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the 2020 upgraded/expanded release of Observer, distinct from the original 2017 version.
